segments.text: She found the password under all bells, blue screen glow in the laundry room
Said just one night I missed that place and clicked her way into the doom
The dinner burned, the school bell rang, her phone lit up with 20 calls
She chased a dragon through the rain while real life cracked along the walls
The guild said ready and she said I am
Never saw the kitchen flooding again
Oh she renewed the subscription
Bought a ticket out of her mind
One more dungeon, one more mission
left the daylight far behind her children got their backpacks crying said mom you want me
talking spells she waved them off without looking down in her glowing little hell
the cat went wild on a toppled plate the landlord knocked then went away her boss left messages in
read she muted every word they'd say she wore a crown of pixels fire at 3 a.m she beat the king
the house grew cold the cupboards bare but victory was everything when silence after server dawn
no party chat no flushing gold she turned around to meet the room and saw how empty it had grown
the cow was staring from the hall with hungry eyes and velvet paws she laughed once thin and
terrified at every consequence she'd lost oh she renewed the subscription and the world withdrew
its hand her kids were gone beyond the driveway her kingdom sank beneath the land the chat climbed
up through broken sunlight as the login music softly played she whispered maybe i can fix this
but the screen said character erased character erased and the last blue light went away
